I've implemented a light theme by introducing CSS variables and a theme toggle. The design now supports switching between a dark and light mode, with the preference being saved to your browser's local storage.

```file:style.css
:root {
  --bg-color: #161618;
  --text-color: #f5f2e9;
  --card-bg: #202022;
  --card-border: #675729;
  --accent-color: #e4c66a;
  --btn-text: #161618;
}

[data-theme="light"] {
  --bg-color: #f5f2e9;
  --text-color: #161618;
  --card-bg: #ffffff;
  --card-border: #d4c59a;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }

body { 
  margin: 0; 
  min-height: 100vh; 
  display: grid; 
  place-items: center; 
  padding: 24px; 
  font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; 
  color: var(--text-color); 
  background: var(--bg-color); 
  transition: background 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease;
}

.card { 
  max-width: 620px; 
  padding: 40px; 
  border: 1px solid var(--card-border); 
  border-radius: 24px; 
  background: var(--card-bg); 
  transition: background 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
}

.eyebrow { 
  color: var(--accent-color); 
  font-size: 12px; 
  letter-spacing: .15em; 
}

h1 { 
  font-size: clamp(30px, 6vw, 52px); 
  line-height: 1.1; 
}

p { 
  line-height: 1.6; 
}

button { 
  border: 0; 
  border-radius: 9px; 
  padding: 12px 20px; 
  color: var(--btn-text); 
  background: var(--accent-color); 
  cursor: pointer; 
  font-weight: 600;
  margin-top: 20px;
}

button:hover {
  opacity: 0.9;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

#theme-toggle {
  position: absolute;
  top: 24px;
  right: 24px;
  padding: 8px 16px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
  background: var(--card-bg);
  color: var(--text-color);
  cursor: pointer;
}
```

```file:index.html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>My first website</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="style.css">
</head>
<body>
  <button id="theme-toggle" type="button">ðŸŒ“ Toggle Theme</button>
  <main class="card">
    <p class="eyebrow">BUILT WITH GEMMA</p>
    <h1>Your idea starts here.</h1>
    <p>Ask Gemma to turn this starter into your own website.</p>
    <button id="hello" type="button">Try me</button>
    <p id="message" aria-live="polite"></p>
  </main>
  <script src="app.js"></script>
</body>
</html>
```

```file:app.js
const themeToggle = document.querySelector('#theme-toggle');
const helloBtn = document.querySelector('#hello');
const message = document.querySelector('#message');

// Theme logic
const currentTheme = localStorage.getItem('theme') || 'dark';
document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', currentTheme);

themeToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
  const newTheme = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';
  document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', newTheme);
  localStorage.setItem('theme', newTheme);
});

// Interaction logic
helloBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
  message.textContent = 'You built something. Keep going!';
});
```
